name: Relação Governada de Avaliação Epistêmica URT-Praxis

flow.step_1: sister_urt exports URT state/evidence references to sister_praxis
flow.step_2: sister_praxis performs rule & invariant assessment without modifying URT state
flow.step_3: sister_praxis returns assessment evidence and recommendation
flow.step_4: authorized human/technical actor in sister_urt executes governed state transition
